prompt: A photo-mode capture from a video game that draws its world and its people in two different ways. Every wall, pavement, lamp and machine is crisp 16-bit pixel art: one even pixel grid, a limited palette of thirty-two colours, hard pixel edges. Only the people are painted in muted realism: weathered faces with real skin texture, stubble and tired eyes, 1930s wool coats, flat caps and worn leather. At night, close to a city building cut open like a doll's house, two floors fill the frame. Street level: a brick red bakery, and in the near foreground the shoulders and backs of protesters in red scarves shoving protesters in blue scarves, mixed ages and skin tones, under a yellow street lamp. Below, through the cut-away floor, an emerald-lit basement where printing presses throw banknotes while gangsters in pinstripe suits play music and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances. Seen low and from the left. Thanks.
